scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w backend && npm run test:cov -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
